brand_presence: Logo bottom left on slide 1, top right on slides 2-7; handle bottom on slides 2-4; about-me and social proof at 5-6

what_makes_it_work: A stark safety rule with a clear visual of the jar and the baby, in a clean 7-slide format. It is a pure information post with no keyword offer, and it got 44 likes and 2 comments, her lowest comment count here.
lumebook_takeaway: A safety-fact post with no free offer or story gets little action; add a keyword or a question if the goal is comments.
